name: nr_prach_family
description: 独立 Python 单个 PRACH 时频机会处理；支持 139/839 点 Zadoff-Chu 序列，显式物理根序号及循环移位。
implementation: Standalone NumPy implementation; explicit limited coverage in tool_registry.json.

params.description: JSON 对象字符串。PRACH: root,sequence_length,cyclic_shift；Detect: received,root,sequence_length,threshold；Grid: sequence_length,nsc,symbols,subcarrier_offset；Indices: sequence_length,subcarrier_offset,nsc,index_base；OFDMInfo: sequence_length,nfft,subcarrier_spacing_hz,cp_samples；OFDMModulate: symbols,nfft,cp_samples。

function.description: 调用的 MATLAB 入口名

result.description: 该入口的结构化计算结果

example.result: 按入口参数返回 JSON 对象；缺失必需参数时返回 error
